Set epsilon=a^(2/n), zeta=sqrt(epsilon)(q+ip). Its leading polynomial is the perfect square |1+C_n e^{-i phi} zeta^n|^2, with n distinct simple zeros; first perturbation is -epsilon*n^2*C_n^2*|zeta|^(2n-2)/2. The order-2n positive leading coefficient excludes negativity outside a fixed compact set uniformly; positive margins exclude all but O(sqrt(epsilon)) root neighborhoods. Translating physical coordinates about zeta_j/sqrt(epsilon), Q_epsilon/epsilon converges in every fixed derivative order to a positive multiple of |w|^2-1/2. Uniform strict convexity and exclusion produce exactly n smooth strictly convex Jordan components, each area ->pi/2. On those regions r^2=(n!/2^n)^(1/n)/epsilon+O(epsilon^-1/2); polynomial upper and negative interior lower bounds prove the logarithmic integrated-mass rate. The packaged script and direct Wigner integrals were inspected as finite corroboration. Independently inspected the complete related 2025 Wigner-nodal paper, whose theorems address rigidity rather than this asymptotic geometry.
